description: Optionally run several scene tools in one call: in order, each on the scene the calls before it left, applied as one undo step, with a report per call. Supports repeated or known-in-advance work; individual calls remain available. A call cannot use an id another call of the same batch creates; created ids are available in the report for subsequent calls. onRefusal stop (default): a refused call stops the batch and nothing is applied; skip: the others are applied and each refusal is reported. This policy includes unsupported tools, invalid inputs and design-brief refusals, as well as runtime refusals. add_object calls are independent of each other under both: one that fails is reported with its own error and the others are applied, each with the receipt a single add_object gives. Tools: paint, search_materials, list_levels, get_node, get_level_summary, get_walls, get_zones, duplicate_level, verify_scene, delete_node, move_node, duplicate_node, measure_stair, fit_stair, find_by_type, create_roof, add_wall, set_wall_type, add_fence, add_level, create_unit, create_stair, add_corner_window, merge_windows, add_column, add_object, place_design, place_in_room.

input.description: That tool's input, as when calling it on its own.

tool.description: One of the tools listed in the description.

onRefusal.description: stop (default): nothing is applied if a call is refused. skip: apply the rest.

name: run_batch
title: Run a batch of scene tools
